# Review Flow Checklist: st-advisor, an on-demand Codex review with no spec folder

**Purpose**: Review the requirements for the new advisor point and skill, the Codex tab and fallback, the CodeRabbit run, and the record outside the tracked files, before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Advisor script and Codex tab

- [ ] CHK001 Is the input of the `review` point (base, run folder, optional plan file) stated with every allowed form and every usage stop? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the mode rule for `review` stated so it is clear how it differs from the `diff` point in modes `codex` and `both`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the three fallback causes listed with the output line for each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it stated that the 1800 s limit applies only to the headless fallback of `review`, and that the tab has no limit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the BLOCKED rule for a change during the review consistent with "finished work only"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the full-review prompt scope (bugs, regressions, security, constitution) stated so a reviewer can tell it apart from the `diff` prompt? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the tab prompt handling tied to a named rule set, with what goes to the user? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## Skill entry and PR form

- [ ] CHK008 Is "the point where the branch left `main`" defined for the no-argument form, with the case of no `main`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "the PR's base" defined for the PR form (which branch, and from which point)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Is each stop case of the PR form (no worktree, HEAD mismatch, PR not readable) paired with a scenario? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Story 2]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it stated how the skill tells a PR number apart from a base ref? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the uncommitted-files case stated with what the user sees? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## External service (CodeRabbit gets PR diffs)

- [ ] CHK013 Is it stated that only the PR form sends code to CodeRabbit, and that the plain form never does? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the user's consent to send PR diffs to CodeRabbit recorded with its source decision? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, decisions.md D18]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the CodeRabbit failure cases (not installed, not signed in, network error, usage limit) covered, with the Codex review still running? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Story 2 Scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it stated that CodeRabbit findings are hypotheses checked against the source, the same as Codex findings? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]

## Records outside the tracked tree

- [ ] CHK017 Is the record path defined for a linked worktree, a branch with `/`, and a detached HEAD? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the entry format of the record (time, diff hash, verdict, findings, CodeRabbit section) stated? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the `.gitignore` rule limited to this repo, with the untracked case in other projects stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Is SC-002 ("`git status` is the same as before") consistent with a record written under the main checkout's `.stratum/`? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, §FR-007]

## Harness skills

- [ ] CHK021 Is it stated that the lane points and feature `advisor.md` files do not change, with a check that can show it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the harness model and drift test update a requirement, not only an assumption? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the limit of automated tests for live tab and CodeRabbit runs stated, with the manual check that replaces them? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
